items.title: Building highly available real-time bidding workloads with AWS RTB Fabric
items.summary: AWS RTB Fabric is a fully managed service purpose-built for real-time bidding that provides high availability as a native capability. This post shows how it delivers AZ-aware routing, built-in health checks, and Multi-AZ gateway resilience for SSP and DSP bidding workloads, and how to migrate to it incrementally from an NLB-based architecture.
items.creator: Terrell Gross
